title: Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud

paragraphs: Avodah Zarah 30a relates that Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Yishmael, fell ill. Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud and the other rabbis went in to inquire after him. As they sat, a question arose; Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud told them, “Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said this in the name of Rabbi Chiya.”
